title: Peripheral serum metabolomic profiles inform central cognitive impairment
summary: Seven serum metabolites associated with cognitive impairment were identified; in baseline cognitively normal participants, the model predicted later conversion to MCI/AD (AUC 0.804; sensitivity 0.722; specificity 0.749). The paired pathway model had AUC 0.778. Retrospective ROS/MAP cohorts: 566 serum samples, 109 postmortem brain samples, and 446 baseline-normal participants (90 later converters). Internal repeated 70/30 splits (100 repetitions); no independent external cohort validation. The reported prediction is association/prognosis, not causal evidence.
ai_technology: Random-forest feature selection and classification used serum metabolite measurements plus age to predict later cognitive conversion from baseline normal cognition.
